title: What Do Moms Wish Their Husbands Knew During Pregnancy?
card: When we asked birth mothers what they wished someone had told their partner, most of them wrote about the months before labor. Here's what they said, in their own words.
llms: What moms wish their husbands knew during pregnancy, in birth mothers' own survey words: learn her needs before labor, come to the prenatal visits, expect a long or complicated labor, say doubts out loud, and plan for how much care she needs after the birth.
